gitCommit.subject: feat: item purge + remove-from-sorts (purses-u3p) (#213)
gitCommit.body:
feat: item purge + remove-from-sorts (purses-u3p) (#213)

* docs(spec): item purge — permanent hard-delete + blob cleanup (purses-u3p)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs(spec): u3p rev-2 — fold Security+Data review (3 FK children, block-409, service, authz-before-confirm)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs(spec): u3p rev-3 — add remove-from-sorts companion op + full Playwright workflow coverage

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs(spec): u3p rev-4 — fold focused re-review (e2e infra: 2-user auth + finalized seed; t9l exception)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs(plan): u3p item purge + remove-from-sorts (6 TDD tasks, e2e workflow)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(dal): requireApiCollectionOwner owner-only gate

Owner-only sibling of requireApiCollectionAccess: resolves the collection
and returns it iff collection.ownerId === userId, else 404 (absent) / 403.
For destructive collection-owner ops (item purge) where membership is
insufficient.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(repo): hard-delete + result-membership methods for item purge

- IItemRepository: findByIdIncludingDeleted (no deletedAt filter) + hardDelete
- IPhotoRepository: hardDeleteByItem -> string[] (DELETE ... RETURNING blob_key,
  ALL rows incl. soft-deleted)
- ICollectionPreferenceItemRepository: deleteByItem (cross-curator, distinct
  from curator-scoped clear)
- ISortResultItemRepository: existsByItem (the purge 409 guard)

Thin DB methods; authoritative coverage is the T3 integration test.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(items): real owner-only item purge — hard-delete + blobs, 409 if in a result (purses-u3p)

POST /api/items/[id]/purge was a no-op stub returning a false 200. Make it a
real permanent purge:

- ItemPurgeService.purge: 409 (ItemInResultError) if the item is in ANY sort
  result; else children-first hard delete (preferences + photos before the
  item, FK has no cascade) in one transaction; http blobs del'd best-effort
  post-commit. Only tx-bound repos write inside the transaction.
- Route: requireAuth (401) -> findByIdIncludingDeleted (404) ->
  requireApiCollectionOwner (404/403) -> parse {confirm:'PURGE'} (400) ->
  purge (409) -> 200. Authz STRICTLY before body parsing.
- Removed the dead ItemController.purgeItem stub.

Un-mocked DB integration test (mocks only @vercel/blob del + auth) proves the
HARD delete via findByIdIncludingDeleted null, photos+prefs gone, http blobs
del'd; plus 409 / 403-member / 404-absent / 403-malformed-body-precedes-parse
/ 400-missing-confirm.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(items): remove-from-sorts — owner bulk-detach an item from draft results (purses-u3p)

Companion to the item purge op: POST /api/items/[id]/remove-from-sorts lets a
collection owner detach an item from every DRAFT sort result in one transaction
(purge-prep), reporting how many FINALIZED results still reference it.

- ISortResultItemRepository: deleteByItemInDraftResults (RETURNING-counted) +
  countByItemInFinalizedResults (innerJoin on finalized status).
- SortResultService.removeItemFromDraftResults — withTransaction, tx-bound repo
  only; finalized result-items + preferences untouched (deliberate t9l exception,
  owner-only/draft-only).
- Route: requireAuth -> findByIdIncludingDeleted (404) -> requireApiCollectionOwner
  (404/403) -> service -> 200 { removed, remainingInFinalized }. Authz before any
  body access; no confirm body (consistent with deleteResultItem).
- Un-mocked DB integration test (mocks only @/lib/auth): item in both a draft and
  a finalized result -> 200 { removed:1, remainingInFinalized:1 }, draft gone /
  finalized survives / prefs untouched; draft-only -> remainingInFinalized:0;
  non-owner member -> 403 (nothing removed); absent item -> 404.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(sort): purge tolerates a blob del failure (best-effort)

A `del` rejection on the external blob boundary must not fail an already-
committed purge: the DB rows (item, photos, prefs) are gone and the route
still returns 200. Pins the Promise.allSettled best-effort contract so a
flaky blob store can never leave an item un-purgeable.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(e2e): entire item-removal workflow — purge + remove-from-sorts (purses-u3p)

API-level Playwright e2e for the whole removal workflow against the prod build
+ ephemeral Postgres (there is no UI for purge / remove-from-sorts). Net-new
harness infra the review flagged:

- e2e/fixtures/api-auth.ts: apiContextFor(playwright, {email,password}) mints a
  per-user authenticated APIRequestContext via the NextAuth credentials API
  (generalizes the single-user auth.setup.ts). The harness ships ONE shared
  storageState; a second, genuinely-distinct authenticated principal is
  required for the authz case.
- seedRemovalScenario(): two users (owner + non-owner), a collection, an item
  with a hero photo, and that item in BOTH a draft and a finalized result. The
  finalized result is built the DB-layer way (status:"finalized" + result-item),
  the sort-results-authz.integration.test.ts pattern. Unique ids per call so it
  seeds without resetDb() (which would wipe the baseline user other specs need).

Cases: (1) un-block→purge chain — 409, remove-from-sorts → remainingInFinalized
0, purge 200, item gone; (2) finalized dead-end — {removed:1,
remainingInFinalized:1}, purge stays 409; (3) authz — non-owner 403 on BOTH ops,
item + both results survive.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs: sync item purge + remove-from-sorts routes + owner-only DAL (purses-u3p)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* chore(graphify): refresh graph for u3p

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(items): remove-from-sorts — owner bulk-detach an item from draft results (purses-u3p)

Companion to the item purge op: POST /api/items/[id]/remove-from-sorts lets a
collection owner detach an item from every DRAFT sort result in one transaction
(purge-prep), reporting how many FINALIZED results still reference it.

- ISortResultItemRepository: deleteByItemInDraftResults (RETURNING-counted) +
  countByItemInFinalizedResults (innerJoin on finalized status).
- SortResultService.removeItemFromDraftResults — withTransaction, tx-bound repo
  only; finalized result-items + preferences untouched (deliberate t9l exception,
  owner-only/draft-only).
- Route: requireAuth -> findByIdIncludingDeleted (404) -> requireApiCollectionOwner
  (404/403) -> service -> 200 { removed, remainingInFinalized }. Authz before any
  body access; no confirm body (consistent with deleteResultItem).
- Un-mocked DB integration test (mocks only @/lib/auth): item in both a draft and
  a finalized result -> 200 { removed:1, remainingInFinalized:1 }, draft gone /
  finalized survives / prefs untouched; draft-only -> remainingInFinalized:0;
  non-owner member -> 403 (nothing removed); absent item -> 404.

* test(sort): purge tolerates a blob del failure (best-effort)

A `del` rejection on the external blob boundary must not fail an already-
committed purge: the DB rows (item, photos, prefs) are gone and the route
still returns 200. Pins the Promise.allSettled best-effort contract so a
flaky blob store can never leave an item un-purgeable.

* test(e2e): entire item-removal workflow — purge + remove-from-sorts (purses-u3p)

API-level Playwright e2e for the whole removal workflow against the prod build
+ ephemeral Postgres (there is no UI for purge / remove-from-sorts). Net-new
harness infra the review flagged:

- e2e/fixtures/api-auth.ts: apiContextFor(playwright, {email,password}) mints a
  per-user authenticated APIRequestContext via the NextAuth credentials API
  (generalizes the single-user auth.setup.ts). The harness ships ONE shared
  storageState; a second, genuinely-distinct authenticated principal is
  required for the authz case.
- seedRemovalScenario(): two users (owner + non-owner), a collection, an item
  with a hero photo, and that item in BOTH a draft and a finalized result. The
  finalized result is built the DB-layer way (status:"finalized" + result-item),
  the sort-results-authz.integration.test.ts pattern. Unique ids per call so it
  seeds without resetDb() (which would wipe the baseline user other specs need).

Cases: (1) un-block→purge chain — 409, remove-from-sorts → remainingInFinalized
0, purge 200, item gone; (2) finalized dead-end — {removed:1,
remainingInFinalized:1}, purge stays 409; (3) authz — non-owner 403 on BOTH ops,
item + both results survive.
